objective: Generate AI covers for several prepared drafts in one confirmed, bounded run; the owner still chooses each image.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Create src/app/dashboard/bulk-cover-generator.tsx and change src/app/dashboard/page.tsx and src/app/dashboard/library-browser.css exactly as specified in the acceptance test header. Use anchored edits for existing files.

Imports to use exactly as quoted: from "@/lib/ai-cover": AI_COVER_STYLES (readonly ["ebook", "software_box"]), AI_COVER_STYLE_LABELS (Readonly<Record<AiCoverStyle, string>>) and type AiCoverStyle. The existing endpoint: GET /api/cover?item=<id>&style=<style> returns JSON { enabled: boolean; reason: string; saved: object | null; error?: string }; POST /api/cover with JSON { item_id, style } returns { saved?: object; error?: string }. Each generation reserves up to US$0.10 of the existing AI cover budget.

bulk-cover-generator.tsx: "use client"; style <select id="bulk-cover-style">; the confirmation text states the maximum spend; the log lists one line per item (skipped, generating, ready, or stopped); disable controls while working; render null when items is empty.

page.tsx: compute the eligible items from the loaded rows (archived_at === null, status "draft", truthy metadata_sha256, non-empty title, cover_object_path not containing "-ai-cover-") and render <BulkCoverGenerator items={...} /> after the Drive import control in the "New draft" section.
library-browser.css: append .bulk-covers (grid with gap and top margin), .bulk-confirm (wrapping flex row) and .bulk-log (small muted list).
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks, together with the existing ai-cover acceptance tests; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
source_manifest_note: Pinned to the merge of bonus-library#54 (archive); computed by the coding assistant with both the Factory reader and the owner's standalone script (137 files); the Factory fetch verifies it independently before use.
